message.content: Lachlan finds Cersei's end particularly haunting, especially given how much she fought to hold onto her power. It felt like the culmination of her actions and the consequences of her choices, which resonated with a tragic poetic quality. Lachlan expresses a desire to see more of Cersei confronting her past decisions and whether she would have been able to face her own mistakes head-on. This sentiment highlights the complexity of Cersei's character arc and the lasting impact of her choices, even in the final moments of the series.
